title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Northgate Imaging Center under your health plan for services provided on August 18, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Our medical policy considers the transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) treatment course unproven for the diagnosis submitted, so it is excluded as investigational. Reason code: CO-55.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $7,203.26 billed. The provider may bill you for this service.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Tamsin Health Partners, Appeals Unit, PO Box 1987, Columbus, OH 43215. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-9318.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
